items.source: A targeted accessor can specify a set of target classes for which it should be called. However, if it returns null or an empty array from getSpecificTargetClasses(), it will typically be called for all access operations and given a chance to determine if it supports a concrete access attempt.
items.translation: 目标访问器可以指定一组应调用它的目标类。然而，如果它从getSpecificTargetClasses()返回`null`或空数组，则通常会对所有访问操作进行调用，并给它机会确定是否支持具体的访问尝试。

items.source: Targeted accessors are considered to be ordered, and each will be called in turn. The only rule that affects the call order is that any accessor which specifies explicit support for a given target type via getSpecificTargetClasses() will be called first, before other generic accessors that do not specify support for explicit target types. In addition, accessors that support the exact target type will be called before accessors that support a supertype of the target type.
items.translation: 目标访问器被视为有序，且将依次被调用。唯一影响调用顺序的规则是：任何通过getSpecificTargetClasses()明确指定对给定目标类型支持的访问器，将在其他未指定对显式目标类型支持的一般性访问器之前被调用。此外，支持确切目标类型的访问器将在支持目标类型超类的访问器之前被调用。

items.source: This interface places no restrictions on what constitutes an element.
items.translation: 该接口对构成元素的内容没有限制。

items.source: Returning null or an empty array indicates this is a generic accessor that can be called in an attempt to access an element on any type.
items.translation: 返回 `null` 或空数组表示这是一个通用访问器，可以调用以尝试访问任何类型上的元素。

items.source: Get the set of classes for which this accessor should be called.
items.translation: 获取应调用此访问器的类集。

items.source: an array of classes that this accessor is suitable for (or null or an empty array if a generic accessor)
items.translation: 一个此访问器适用的类数组（或如果是通用访问器则为 `null` 或空数组）
